reasons.meaning: A baton result exists but does not contain valid geometry for the metric.
A hand is over or immediately adjacent to the baton.
The baton detector found a candidate but did not consider it reliable enough to use.
The expected baton was not found.
The baton geometry did not reproduce under the existing resize repeatability check.
The expected baton result object is missing from the analyser result.
The detected baton is in the wrong geometric location for the expected marker.
The 12-marker centring measurement moves beyond the existing repeatability allowance under resize.
The dial edge could not be fitted automatically.
The fitted dial edge does not reproduce when the photo is reduced by the existing test scales.
The dial frame is a hand-aligned circle and therefore has no reproducible automatic edge fit.
The analyser did not find a usable dial candidate in the photo.
The automatic dial location candidate exists but its confidence is below the existing usable threshold.
The 12-marker gap measurement moves beyond the existing repeatability allowance under resize.
A hand is touching or immediately beside the 12 triangle and can shift its measured outline.
Only the inner lume outline was measured, which is not the intended outer edge for the 12 gap metric.
The minute-track 60 reference required by the 12 rotation metric was not located.
The minute-track reference required by 12 gap/centring was not located.
The detected landmark relation is geometrically degenerate and cannot produce a meaningful line-offset metric.
The 12-marker rotation measurement moves beyond the existing repeatability allowance under resize.
Fewer than the required number of usable round-marker measurements exist for this metric.
Too few round markers survive the existing resize repeatability gate.
The 12 triangle was not found as a usable candidate.
The selected 12 triangle is not reproduced as the same physical outline at the existing resize scales.
The detected 12 triangle is below the existing minimum pixel width for reliable measurement.
A result carried no registered reason code; this sentinel is never valid in a persisted measurement contract.
